label.checking.purpose: Label of an Inbox file the app is still fingerprinting and matching. It has no actions yet.
label.checking.where: Inbox, a row's label and its filter chip.

label.new_to_you.purpose: Label of an Inbox file whose track is not in the Library.
label.new_to_you.where: Inbox, a row's label and its filter chip.

label.better_file.purpose: Label of an Inbox file that ranks above the file a Library track uses now.
label.better_file.where: Inbox, a row's label and its filter chip.

label.other_cut.purpose: Label of an Inbox file that is another cut of a Library track.
label.other_cut.where: Inbox, a row's label and its filter chip.

label.rework.purpose: Label of an Inbox file that is a rework of a Library track.
label.rework.where: Inbox, a row's label and its filter chip.

label.already_have.purpose: Label of an Inbox file whose track is in the Library and which adds nothing.
label.already_have.where: Inbox, a row's label and its filter chip.

filter.label.purpose: Accessible name of the row of filter chips.
filter.label.where: Inbox, above the list (screen readers only).

filter.all.purpose: Filter chip that shows every label.

reason.checking.purpose: Why a file has no real label yet.

reason.checkingOnlineOnly.purpose: Why a OneDrive-style online-only file is not read yet.

reason.newToYou.purpose: Why a file is New to you.

reason.alreadyHave.purpose: Why a file is Already have.

reason.otherCut.purpose: Why a file is an Other cut, when the link has no name.

reason.otherCut_labeled.purpose: Why a file is an Other cut, with the link's name (for example radio).

reason.rework.purpose: Why a file is a Rework, when the link has no name.

reason.rework_labeled.purpose: Why a file is a Rework, with the link's name (for example remix).

batch.loose.purpose: Heading of the group of files that landed in an Inbox folder itself, not in a subfolder.

batch.arrived.purpose: When a group of files arrived. The time is filled in.

batch.count_one.purpose: How many files a group holds, one.

batch.count_other.purpose: How many files a group holds.

action.add.purpose: Main button on a row: adds the file to the Library.

action.addAll.purpose: Adds every file of a group to the Library that can be added.

action.addAnyway.purpose: Confirms an add that was held back because the file has a low bitrate.
action.addAnyway.where: Inbox, a row or group heading, after the warning.

action.notNow.purpose: Sets a file aside without deciding. Undo brings it back.

action.hide.purpose: Hides a file from the app's lists. Plain text, hard to hit by accident. Undo brings it back.

action.clear.purpose: Clears a file that is already in the Library from the Inbox.

action.clearAll.purpose: Clears every Already have file at once.

confirm.lowBitrate.purpose: Warning that a file has a low bitrate, shown before it is added.
confirm.lowBitrate.where: Inbox, a row or group heading.

skipped.title_one.purpose: Heading of what Add all left out, when it is one file.
skipped.title_one.where: Inbox, a group after Add all.

skipped.title_other.purpose: Heading of what Add all left out.
skipped.title_other.where: Inbox, a group after Add all.

skipped.line.purpose: One file Add all left out with its reason. File name and reason are filled in.
skipped.line.where: Inbox, a group after Add all.

refusal.itemGone.purpose: Why an action was refused: the file is not in the Inbox any more.
refusal.itemGone.where: Inbox, beside a row or under Add all.

refusal.alreadyDecided.purpose: Why an action was refused: the file was already added, hidden or cleared.
refusal.alreadyDecided.where: Inbox, beside a row or under Add all.

refusal.notIdentified.purpose: Why an action was refused: the file is still being identified.
refusal.notIdentified.where: Inbox, beside a row or under Add all.

refusal.hasLibraryTrack.purpose: Why an action was refused: the file's track is in the Library already.
refusal.hasLibraryTrack.where: Inbox, beside a row or under Add all.

refusal.noLibraryTrack.purpose: Why Clear was refused: the file's track is not in the Library.

refusal.fileMissing.purpose: Why an action was refused: the file is not on disk.
refusal.fileMissing.where: Inbox, beside a row or under Add all.

refusal.inRekordboxAsAnotherFile.purpose: Why an add was refused: rekordbox has the track as another file, so it would arrive as a second entry.
refusal.inRekordboxAsAnotherFile.where: Inbox, beside a row or under Add all.

refusal.matchNotConfirmed.purpose: Why an add was refused: the rekordbox match is only probable so far.
refusal.matchNotConfirmed.where: Inbox, beside a row or under Add all.

refusal.sameTrackTwice.purpose: Why an add was refused: another file of the same track is in the same add.

refusal.isLibraryFile.purpose: Why Hide, Not now or Clear was refused: the file is the one a Library track uses.

already.title.purpose: Heading of the collapsed group of files already in the Library. The count is filled in.

doneForYou.title.purpose: Heading of the group of new files that were on a wishlist: added to the Library by the app on its own, or matched and left for the user.
doneForYou.title.where: Inbox, top of the list, only when such files are there.

doneForYou.wish.purpose: Which wishlist item a file matched: the wishlist's name, then the artist and title as the wishlist has them (all data).
doneForYou.wish.where: Inbox, Done for you group, each row.

doneForYou.added.purpose: Says the app added this file to the Library on its own because it was the exact track on a wishlist. Undo in the top bar takes it back.
doneForYou.added.where: Inbox, Done for you group, a row's label.

doneForYou.leftToYou.purpose: Says the file matched a wishlist track but the app did not add it on its own (it needs the user's OK first, or the user undid the automatic add).
doneForYou.leftToYou.where: Inbox, Done for you group, a row's label.

folders.title.purpose: Heading of the section that lists the Inbox folders.

folders.help.purpose: Says what an Inbox folder is and that its files are only read.

folders.none.purpose: Says no Inbox folder is set up.

folders.add.purpose: Button that opens the folder picker to add an Inbox folder.

folders.remove.purpose: Button that removes an Inbox folder (its files stay on disk).
folders.remove.where: Inbox, Inbox folders section, on a folder.

folders.removeNamed.purpose: Accessible name of the remove button, with the folder's path.
folders.removeNamed.where: Inbox, Inbox folders section (screen readers and hover).

folders.firstLook.purpose: Says a new Inbox folder has not been looked at yet, so nothing arrives from it.
folders.firstLook.where: Inbox, Inbox folders section, on a folder.

empty.noFolders.purpose: Tells the user what to do when no Inbox folder exists yet.
empty.noFolders.where: Inbox, when there is nothing to show.

empty.zero.purpose: Plain line when Inbox folders exist and nothing is new.
empty.zero.where: Inbox, when there is nothing to show.
